doctrines.title: The End of the Hierarchy
doctrines.thesis: The organizational hierarchy was never a management philosophy. It was a technology workaround — a system of human-powered information routing built to compensate for the computational and communication constraints of pre-digital organizations. Those constraints no longer exist.
doctrines.tagline: The hierarchy was a workaround for a problem that no longer exists.

doctrines.title: Capabilities Over Features
doctrines.thesis: Features are outputs. Capabilities are engines. A feature is a thing you have delivered; a Capability is a formally defined, measured, continuously improving production process. Features do not compound. Capabilities do.
doctrines.tagline: Features are what you have done. Capabilities are what you are getting better at doing.

doctrines.title: The World Model Imperative
doctrines.thesis: Every organization already has a World Model — implicit, fragmented, lossy. The question is whether you make it explicit, structured, queryable. Making the World Model explicit is the fundamental infrastructure decision of the agentic era.
doctrines.tagline: The tools change. The model is yours.

doctrines.title: The Partner Doctrine
doctrines.thesis: SavvPro does not go to market alone. A SavvPro partner is not a reseller. It is an organization that carries the client relationship in a defined market and is backed by SavvPro's full intelligence infrastructure. The relationship is structural, two-directional, and designed to compound.
doctrines.tagline: We are the backbone. The partner is the surface. The roles do not overlap.

contributor_pathway.description: Remote-first. Resource-agnostic. Agent-first. No hierarchy. Read the page. If it still sounds right, start the conversation.

tier_1_traits.name: Truth Signal Quality
tier_1_traits.description: Reports what is actually happening, not what is comfortable. Delivery data accurate, status honest.
tier_1_traits.counter: Not a fit if your default move is to round the estimate or omit the uncomfortable signal.

tier_1_traits.name: Integrity Under Pressure
tier_1_traits.description: Commitments hold when work is hard. Flags problems early. Discipline does not wobble when no one is watching.
tier_1_traits.counter: Not a fit if pressure changes what you say is true.

tier_1_traits.name: Learning Velocity
tier_1_traits.description: Converts real-world signal into improved capability faster than the room average.
tier_1_traits.counter: Not a fit if you need a six-month ramp to feel competent.
